title: Task-Based CT Protocol Optimization Using Reinforcement Learning and Virtual Imaging Trials
abstract: arXiv:2609.13309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protocol optimization in computed tomography (CT) aims to improve diagnostic image quality while reducing radiation dose, but the interdependence of acquisition and reconstruction parameters makes exhaustive testing impractical. We propose a virtual imaging trial framework with reinforcement learning for efficient CT protocol optimization. Sixty-three computational human models with liver lesions were imaged using a validated CT simulator across 468 combinations of acquisition and reconstruction parameters, including tube voltage, tube current, reconstruction kernel, slice thickness, and pixel size. The optimization objective balanced liver lesion detectability, quantified by detectability index d-prime, against radiation dose. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent was trained and conditioned on patient-specific CT localizer embeddings derived from a pretrained vision transformer. translated_title: 基于任务驱动的CT协议优化：利用强化学习与虚拟成像试验
translated_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）的协议优化旨在提高诊断图像质量的同时降低辐射剂量，但采集与重建参数之间的相互依赖性使得穷举测试难以实现。我们提出了一种结合强化学习的虚拟成像试验框架，用于高效的CT协议优化。研究使用经过验证的CT模拟器，对63个带有肝脏病灶的计算人体模型，在468种采集与重建参数组合（包括管电压、管电流、重建核、层厚和像素大小）下进行成像。优化目标是在肝脏病灶可探测性（以可探测性指数d-prime量化）与辐射剂量之间取得平衡。研究训练了一个近端策略优化（PPO）智能体，并以基于预训练视觉Transformer提取的患者特异性CT定位像嵌入作为条件输入。在留出的测试患者上，每位患者仅需评估8种协议（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合强化学习与虚拟成像试验的CT协议优化框架，通过患者特异性的定位像嵌入和近端策略优化，在大幅减少需评估协议数量的情况下，为每位患者自动找到兼顾肝脏病灶可探测性与辐射剂量的最优扫描方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a virtual imaging trial framework with reinforcement learning that efficiently optimizes CT protocols per patient, balancing liver lesion detectability and radiation dose while requiring evaluation of only a small fraction of possible acquisition and reconstruction parameter combinations.
